categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Longtu Photomask Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor photomasks. The company focuses on high-precision photomasks primarily used in semiconductor manufacturing, including quartz and soda-lime glass photomasks. Its products serve various semiconductor fields such as power semiconductors, MEMS sensors, IC packaging, and analog ICs, targeting applications in new energy, photovoltaics, automotive electronics, industrial control, wireless communication, IoT, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on proprietary technologies including CAM layout processing, optical proximity correction (OPC), precise alignment mark technology, phase shift mask (PSM) layout processing, electron beam lithography and overlay techniques, dry etching, defect detection and repair, and exposure fine control. It has developed a comprehensive technology system covering CAM, lithography, and inspection processes. Production involves customized design and manufacturing based on customer specifications, with full in-house capabilities from layout processing to exposure, development, etching, cleaning, and inspection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor wafer manufacturers, MEMS sensor producers, advanced packaging companies, and research institutions. The company serves domestic chip manufacturers and design companies, including well-known clients such as Huahong Hongli, Chiplink Integration, Silan Microelectronics, Lianwei Microelectronics, Yandong Microelectronics, New Tang Technology, BYD Semiconductor, Yuexin Semiconductor, Changfei Advanced, and Yangjie Technology. End markets span new energy, automotive electronics, industrial control, wireless communication, IoT, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing facilities in Shenzhen and Zhuhai. It serves domestic markets extensively and has growing sales in Taiwan. Overseas sales accounted for a small but growing portion of revenue, mainly to Taiwanese customers. The company’s supply chain includes international suppliers mainly from Japan and Taiwan for key raw materials and equipment.
categories.supply_chain_position: Longtu Photomask operates as an upstream to midstream supplier in the semiconductor supply chain, producing photomasks which are critical upstream materials used by semiconductor wafer fabs for chip manufacturing. It is an independent third-party photomask manufacturer, distinct from wafer fabs that produce their own masks internally, focusing on mature and specialty process nodes above 28nm.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment to advance photomask technology, targeting process nodes from 130nm down to 65nm and below. It focuses on developing third-generation photomasks including PSM products, enhancing resolution and defect control technologies, and expanding capabilities in CAM software, lithography, etching, and inspection. Strategic initiatives include building a high-end semiconductor photomask manufacturing base in Zhuhai, increasing domestic substitution of imported photomasks, and strengthening talent acquisition and innovation ecosystems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized semiconductor photomasks to wafer fabs and semiconductor manufacturers. The company uses a direct sales model with some sales through agents, especially for Taiwan customers. Pricing is based on product cost plus reasonable margins, adjusted for market competition and customer specifications.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global photomask market is dominated by a few international giants such as Photronics (USA), Toppan and DNP (Japan), which control over 80% of the independent third-party market. Longtu Photomask is among the leading domestic independent photomask manufacturers in China, competing mainly in mature and specialty process nodes (130nm and above). It is recognized as a leading domestic player with growing market share and technological capabilities, though still behind international leaders in advanced nodes below 28nm.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 246.5 million, a 12.92% increase over 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 91.8 million, up 9.84%. Total assets and net assets more than doubled due to the successful IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market in August 2024, raising net proceeds of RMB 553.46 million. The company employs 247 staff with a strong R&D team of 43 personnel. It maintains a healthy gross margin around 57% and continues to invest about 9.35% of revenue in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Longtu Photomask emphasizes its strong independent R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and comprehensive in-house production processes that enable high-precision, customized photomask solutions. It offers stable, high-quality products with strong defect control and alignment precision, supporting domestic semiconductor manufacturers’ needs for specialty and mature process nodes. The company’s ability to rapidly iterate products, maintain close customer relationships, and provide tailored technical services differentiates it in the domestic market and supports import substitution efforts.
